user.title: Connect your browser over SSH
user.description: The worker runs on the SSH host and connects to Chromium there. Provide a verified host key and a private key file available inside Home Assistant. Employee login follows in the next step.

account.title: Your employee account
account.description: Use your employee login. Reconfigure can change company, username and password. Blank secret fields keep saved values. An optional otpauth://totp/... URI enables automatic authenticator codes.

mfa.title: Verify your login
mfa.description: Enter a current six-digit code or your authenticator’s otpauth://totp/... URI. The URI is saved for future logins; individual codes are never stored.

error.worker_auth: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and private key file.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the SSH host or worker. Check SSH access and the installed Nix package.
error.browser_unavailable: The worker cannot reach its browser. Check the browser service.
error.incompatible_worker: The worker protocol is incompatible. Update the integration and worker together.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the company ID, user ID and password.
error.invalid_code: The authenticator code was rejected or the challenge expired. Try a fresh code, or restart authentication.
error.unsupported_mfa: This login requires an unsupported second factor or interactive challenge. Use an authenticator-enabled employee login.
error.session_expired: The employee session expired. Authenticate again.
error.different_account: This entry belongs to a different employee. Add another integration entry for a different account.
error.portal_changed: The portal could not be read reliably. Check for portal changes and update the worker.
error.busy: The browser worker is busy. Try again shortly.
error.not_found: The employee session was not found. Start authentication again.
error.invalid_request: The worker rejected this request. Update the integration and worker together.
error.ssh_host_key: SSH host key verification failed. Verify the host and reconfigure the known_hosts entry.
error.invalid_totp: Invalid TOTP URI. Use otpauth://totp/... with a Base32 secret and six digits.

abort.already_configured: This employee account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This entry belongs to a different employee. Add another integration entry for a different account.

worker_auth.title: SSH authentication needs attention
worker_auth.description: SSH authentication for {name} failed. Reconfigure the username and private key file.

worker_unavailable.title: Browser worker unavailable
worker_unavailable.description: SSH or Chromium for {name} is unavailable. Check the SSH connection, worker package and browser. Updates resume automatically when the connection returns.

portal_changed.title: HR WORKS portal needs attention
portal_changed.description: The worker cannot reliably read {name}. Update the worker for the current portal layout. Missing values are unavailable; they are never replaced with zero.

confirm.title: Working time reviewed
confirm.description: Review the affected day directly in HR WORKS. Confirm only after checking which entries were saved and whether an open draft needs removal. This confirmation clears the repair notice; it does not change working times.

ssh_host_key.title: Verify the SSH host key
ssh_host_key.description: The SSH host key for {name} could not be verified. Verify the host and update known_hosts through Reconfigure.

select_account.message: Select one loaded HR WORKS account using config_entry_id.

writes_disabled.message: Enable working-time submissions in integration options before saving entries.

record_working_time.name: Record working time
record_working_time.description: Preview or submit one completed interval. Lunch breaks and doctor appointments remain separate entries.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Check the interval and overlaps without saving anything.
